# Slime People
###Air, Unlimited Air, but no air. Slimepeople [italic](unlike most species)[/italic] breathe [bold][color=#f65044]Nitrogen[/bold] (N2)[/color] instead of [color=#2694d6][bold]Oxygen[/bold] (O2)[/color]. \nIt's abundant in the station's atmosphere, but rarer to find compressed into portable gas tanks. \nThey [bold]suffocate 80% slower[/bold], but take [bold]9% more barotrauma damage[/bold]. This makes them by far the species most capable to survive when the air is thin, or spaced completely.
###Oh god it burns! They take [italic]significant burns[/italic] when [bold]slashed or sprayed with [color=#75b1f0]Water[/color][/bold], but passively heal burns twice as fast. \nThey still need to drink it to stay hydrated, and can do so safely.
###It has pockets! Slimepeople have an [bold]internal 2x3 storage inventory[/bold] inside of their slime membrane. Anyone can see what's inside and take it out of you without asking, so be careful.
###Full of chemicals. They exhale nitrous oxide and are unaffected by it, and can process 6 reagents a second, instead of just 2. \nTheir slime "blood" can not be regenerated from iron, though can be syringed up off the floor, and injected back into their bodies \n[bold][color=#2cf274]Slime[/color][/bold] is technically a source of food for other species, although drinking the blood of your coworkers is [italic]usually[/italic] frowned upon.
###Damage. They take [bold][color=#1e90ff]40% less Blunt damage[/color][/bold], but [bold][color=#ffa500]50% more Cold damage, 20% more Slash damage and 20% more Piercing damage[/color][/bold]. Their punches do [italic]5 blunt damage[/italic]
